info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Trade Banking By Param1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of credit limits in trade banking by allowing clients to update specific credit limit parameters. It is designed for financial institutions and their partners to efficiently adjust credit limits based on changing business needs or client profiles. Users can utilize this endpoint to enforce better credit management practices, ensuring that credit limits are accurately reflected in real time. Typical consumers include banking staff and system integrators who require seamless interactions with credit data in their applications.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the credit limit associated with the specified resource. Use this endpoint to modify the credit limits based on your business needs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the credit limits for a specific trade banking operation identified by RES-100045. It should include the necessary fields to specify the new credit limits and any other relevant information required for the operation.
